description_full: Prudential plc, through its subsidiaries, provides life and health insurance, and asset management solutions to individuals in Asia and Africa. It offers savings and investments products; and wealth, health, and protection products. The company was founded in 1848 and is headquartered in Central, Hong Kong.
ceo_bio: Mr. Anil  Wadhwani | CEO & Executive Director | Age 57 | Compensation: $5.0M (FY2025)
culture_narrative: Employs approximately 15K people. Revenue per employee of $749K ranks in the above the sector median among Financial Services peers, with revenue falling 20%/yr across its filed history. CEO compensation is 7× revenue per employee (modest relative to workforce productivity).
financial_summary: Prudential Public Limited Compa is a large-cap financial services business with a $31.2B market cap on $11.5B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at -19% over the past three years, and a shrinking top line is the hardest headwind any business can overcome.
Returns on capital run at 18% against a 9% cost of capital, a 9-point spread that creates value, though narrow enough that competitive pressure could close it.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year.

Management returns a meaningful 6.3% of market cap to owners through dividends and buybacks, a strong signal of disciplined capital allocation, and insider ownership is negligible, so management has little personal stake in the long-term outcome.

prof: ROIC of 18% clears the cost of capital of 9.1% by 9pp, the mark of a value creator; returns have swung a lot from year to year (CV 0.41).
